description.p: ohmail is an email client for the mailbox you already have. It connects to your own IMAP server over TLS, mirrors your mail to a database on this computer, and files new mail into ohmail/ folders on the server itself — where every other mail app you own can see it.

First-time senders wait in the Screener until you say where they belong. Nothing is filed out of your inbox before you have decided, and a decision you make here is a folder move on your server, so it is still true when you read the same mailbox on your phone.
The app carries its own mail engine and the runtime it runs on. Your mail server is the only thing it talks to; this build does not check for updates, because your software centre installs them.
It works with any IMAP account — your own server, a hosting provider, or a mailbox from a large provider that issues app passwords. There is no account to create to use it.
